title: Roleplay and Floor-Play Corner
description: One static play-corner scene. One complete open-oven play kitchen forms a roleplay station against the rear-left wall; three whole floor toys form a separate stacking and pretend-play area, with a whole bench behind them. All five published models retain full meshes and PBR at unit scale; scene-only floor and low cutaway walls, no new independent model. Open center and front entrance. No child dimensions, age suitability, ergonomic, toy safety, motion or building-code claim. Complete original mesh hierarchy, oriented triangles and solid PBR are preserved. One scene preset and zero new independent reusable models.
